steps: Confirm you are registered to vote in Chester County.
Submit the poll worker application (610-344-6410 or pollworkers@chesco.org); parties/Voter Services fill by appointment.
Serve Election Day: full day 6:00AM-about 9:30PM (judge/inspectors); clerks full or half-day; $175-$250 by role.
timing: Judge of Elections and inspectors work full day 6:00AM-about 9:30PM; clerks can choose full or half-day shifts. Training begins ~6 weeks before each election.
